raw:
@q query
  mode count
  select ?x
  where all
    match
      relation "be open"
      role subject ?x
      role object "P1 incident"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "belong to"
      role subject ?x
      role object "the payments team"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be old"
      role subject ?x
      role object ?age
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  compare ?age above 3 days
